semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Lindenbridge Inc. provides components like inductors, chokes, transformers, and sensors which are integral to semiconductor applications, particularly in low power electronics and sensor applications.
summary: Lindenbridge Inc. is a manufacturer of electronic components such as inductors, chokes, transformers, sensors, cores, and filters. With over 35 years of experience, the company is ISO certified and focuses on high-quality products for low power electronics and sensor applications, serving the semiconductor value chain with reliable service and quick delivery.
capabilities: Specialization in low power electronics components
